shared_elements: low-relief incised curvilinear motifs on a rounded stone surface
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry shallow incised curvilinear carving including a rounded disc- or spiral-like form, something any carving tradition could produce independently. A depicts an explicit figural scene of four standing human figures in profile facing one another beneath a register of small sign-like glyphs, whereas B shows only isolated abstract/curled motifs with no figures, no interaction between elements and no register organisation.
